description_en: Updates the login switch, member synchronization switch, or application configuration of a specified external identity provider in a workspace. Unspecified properties remain unchanged. The update is an asynchronous operation. After the API returns, you can call GetIdentityProvider to query the status and track progress
description_zh: 更新指定工作空间外部身份提供商的登录开关、成员同步开关或应用配置。未指定的属性保持不变。更新为异步操作，接口返回后可通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询 status 跟踪进展
name: UpdateIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk, Feishu
parameters.help_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether workspace users are allowed to log on through this external identity provider
fields.help_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录
fields.name: login_enabled

fields.help_en: The App ID of the Lark application. This parameter is required when the binding type is Feishu
fields.help_zh: 飞书应用的 App ID。绑定类型为 Feishu 时必填
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The AppKey of the DingTalk application. This parameter is required when the binding type is DingTalk
fields.help_zh: 钉钉应用的 AppKey。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填
fields.name: app_key

fields.help_en: Required. The secret of the external identity provider application. This parameter is write-only and is not returned by query operations
fields.help_zh: 必填。外部身份提供商应用的密钥。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: app_secret

fields.help_en: The CorpId of the DingTalk organization. This parameter is required when the binding type is DingTalk
fields.help_zh: 钉钉企业的 CorpId。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填
fields.name: corp_id

fields.help_en: The data encryption key for event subscriptions. The value must be consistent with the one configured in the external identity provider application. This parameter is write-only and is not returned by query operations
fields.help_zh: 事件订阅的数据加密密钥，取值与外部身份提供商应用中配置的一致。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: encrypt_key

fields.help_en: The verification token for event subscriptions. The value must be consistent with the one configured in the external identity provider application. This parameter is write-only and is not returned by query operations
fields.help_zh: 事件订阅的校验令牌，取值与外部身份提供商应用中配置的一致。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: verification_token

fields.help_en: The new application configuration of the external identity provider. If not specified, the existing configuration remains unchanged
fields.help_zh: 新的外部身份提供商应用配置，不指定时保持不变
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable organization member synchronization. After this feature is enabled, the external identity provider synchronizes organization members as workspace users
fields.help_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户
fields.name: sync_enabled

parameters.help_en: The request body for updating the external identity provider
parameters.help_zh: 更新外部身份提供商的请求内容
parameters.name: body
